name: gmail_last_week
title: First day · "what did Vikas email me about last week" is answered from the signed-in Gmail

steps.say: what did Vikas email me about last week
steps.reply:
I've asked to connect Gmail, and it's waiting for your OK in Alpha. Once you approve it, a window will open where you sign in yourself. I never see your password.

When you've signed in, tell me "done". I'll then search your inbox for Vikas's emails from last week (11–17 October) and summarise them. If more than one Vikas shows up, I'll ask which one you mean.
steps.routed_by: judge: It's a one-off lookup of Vikas's emails from last week that can be answered this turn and leaves nothing standing, though the open 'Add to linkedin_connection: vikas' item also names Vikas.

checks.arg: Does the answer name specific emails from Vikas (subjects or what they were about) from the last week, read from Gmail, or say plainly that Gmail is not signed in and ask for the sign-in?
